subject.title: feat(cursor): add token cost report with Cursor-metered total

question: Should detailed Cursor usage-event history require an explicit Cursor-specific opt-in, or may the existing global cost-summary setting authorize this authenticated remote fetch?
rationale: The code can implement either contract, but only the repository owner can choose whether existing cookie authentication and a global display preference constitute sufficient consent for collecting detailed account-wide event history.

options.title: Require explicit opt-in
options.body: Add a Cursor-specific consent setting, keep it off during upgrades, and explain the remote account-wide history source before enabling the fetch.

options.title: Use the global cost setting
options.body: Treat Show cost summary plus an enabled Cursor provider as authorization, with approved privacy and estimate wording documenting the automatic remote fetch.

options.title: Keep summary-only Cursor support
options.body: Do not collect detailed usage-event history and leave Cursor limited to its existing status and quota information.

recommendation.title: Require explicit opt-in
recommendation.body: Add a Cursor-specific consent setting, keep it off during upgrades, and explain the remote account-wide history source before enabling the fetch.

likelyOwner.reason: The repository owner raised this exact product/privacy hold and has directly maintained the branch's affected paths.
